assumptions: schema proofs are not empirical capability proofs
resource comparison is vector-valued unless prices are preregistered
negative-twin minimality is local to one declared dependency
strongest_parent: per-row operational null/envelope with first refusal
falsifier: missing field/leak/unmatched resource/parent non-separation/twin non-collapse/remint failure

definitions.A0: task spec + legal observations/messages/actions through decision time + own legal state; no protected labels, future/judge state, twin identity, or uncharged side channels
definitions.S0: paired u∈[0,1]: d+=u(M,w+)-u(P,w+), d-=u(M,w-)-u(P,w-); beta=alpha/2; require mean(d+)-sqrt(2 ln(1/beta)/n)>tau_parent and |mean(d-)|+sqrt(2 ln(1/beta)/n)<=tau_twin
definitions.N0: remove exactly one registered capability-requiring conditional dependency; keep reward/action/scoring/remint family/non-target budgets matched
definitions.P0: best preregistered parent-envelope member under same allowed information restriction and resource budget gets first refusal

resource_dimensions.sensor_reads: charged accesses to environment observations or observation elements
resource_dimensions.compute_ops: registered implementation-independent work units or, when unavailable, wall/CPU proxy reported with hardware
resource_dimensions.latency_ms: end-to-end decision latency in milliseconds on registered hardware
resource_dimensions.memory_bits: peak retained task-relevant state measured or upper-bounded in bits
resource_dimensions.sample_count: training/evaluation samples consumed before protected scoring
resource_dimensions.communication_bits: bits transmitted across an agent/tool boundary, including protocol overhead
resource_dimensions.modification_count: self-directed changes to update/control/search policy admitted by the harness
